subject: label position in grouped bar plots

messages.author: 81b8804ea0f6b938
messages.subject: label position in grouped bar plots
parts:
Hi all,
I am quite new to this, so I apologize if this might be trivial, but
I'll be more than glad about any hint on this problem:
I have a graph with several grouped bars for which I would like to
indicate significance levels (if appropiate). I have coded this
information into a character-variable (sig). (I also apologize for the
stupid example, but I am not too familiar with all the available
datasets).

group <- c('Group A', 'Group A', 'Group A', 'Group B', 'Group B',
'Group B','Group C', 'Group C', 'Group C')
test <- c('Test1', 'Test2', 'Test3', 'Test1', 'Test2', 'Test3',
'Test1', 'Test2', 'Test3')
value <- c(5, 8, NA, 4, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10)
sig <- c('***', '*', '', '', '***','', '*', '***', '*')
gdata <- data.frame (group, test, value, sig)

gplot <- ggplot(data = gdata, aes(x=test, y=value, fill=group, width =
0.5))+
geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge")+
scale_x_discrete("", limits=c("Test2", "Test1", "Test3")) # I picked
this up to get the bars in the right order

Now I want to put the info on the significance-level above the
corresponding bar, but I am not really sure how to approach this. I
could create a separate dataframe for the positioning information; in
this case the y-position is easy to calculate, but I can't figure out
how to to get the x-values right. I could also use "label", but this
stacks up the values in the center of the bars.
I also need the solution to be flexible enough so that I am able to
change the order of the tests (as in scale_x_discrete). Also sometimes
the test results are not available (as in Test3 in Group A), so that
only 2 bars are created.

Thanks,

Kai

messages.subject: Re: label position in grouped bar plots
parts:
awesome, thanks!
Now, I admit that I don't really fully understand dodging. Is there any way to adapt this to this graph here, where I use this little workaround to add spaces between the groups (as seen on: http://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/6204/how-to-increase-the-space-between-the-bars-in-a-bar-plot-in-ggplot2)? Or even a better way to increase spacing between grouped bars?

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
gplot <- ggplot(data = gdata, aes(x=test, y=value, fill=group, width =

0.5))+ # WORKAROUND
geom_bar(stat="identity", position=pd) +
geom_bar(stat="identity", position=pd, colour="black", legend=FALSE) +
scale_x_discrete("", limits=c("Test2", "Test1", "Test3"))+
geom_text(aes(label = sig, y=ypos), position = pd)

Thanks!

Kai

messages.subject: Re: label position in grouped bar plots
parts:
Hi,

try this:

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
ggplot(data = gdata, aes(x=test, y=value, fill=group))+
geom_bar(aes(width = 0.5), stat="identity", position=pd) +

width aes should be set only for bar.
